text: (Note that the rating system says, "Rate this app *for phone*".) It looks like everybody is unhappy with the keyboard, and I don't blame them. I pay to use Typeless on my desktop, but when it comes to my phone, the user interface makes it almost impossible to use. So, I use the free WisprFlow, instead. Now, if WisprFlow ever starts charging for their Android version, then I'll likely switch over.
